verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents merging existing issues or unmerging/splitting a wrongly collapsed group. The 'Fingerprint Rules' item is a bare title for an adjacent grouping-configuration feature, not merge or split of existing issues. The 'Bulk Mutate a List of Issues' and 'Issue Status' items are titles only, with no mention of merge or unmerge, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can merge issues that are really the same bug and split ones the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed
